explanation: The 2020-03-15 document contains massive substantive policy action: an emergency rate cut to 0-0.25%, commitment to purchase at least $500B in Treasuries and $200B in agency MBS, and expanded repo operations — all representing an unprecedented crisis-response regime shift that plausibly drove the structural break detected around April 9, as markets continued to reprice the full implications of this bazooka intervention and the subsequent facility announcements (PDCF, MMLF, CPFF) referenced in the April 29 document as having relieved funding stress.
